title.zh: Introducing System One Models and Jev
title.en: Introducing System One Models and Jev

current_state.zh: Typesafe.ai introduces System One Models and Jev, a system that trades general-purpose generation for fast typed inference, sparking debate over its novelty relative to existing encoder models.
